svg.aria-label: Round-trip times through a 10 Mbit/s bottleneck with pfifo, codel and fq_codel holding the queue
svg.text: slow start fills all 1000 slots, then ~513 packets stand
ping shares the one queue: up to 52 ms
ping has its own queue: 40.4 ms, max 41.3
